rationale: Intentional public read path for the signed-out marketing regulatory-updates page, mirroring public.verify_certificate. list_regulatory_updates is SECURITY DEFINER with a fixed status='published' filter and search_path pinned to 'public', so anon callers can only read already-published feed rows -- draft/archived content and the base table stay unreachable (no anon table grant).

Intentional public walk-up path for /report-safety posters and QR codes. SECURITY DEFINER with search_path pinned empty; accepts only an opaque facility token (or legacy UUID) and returns facilityId/name/token — never a facility directory. Mirrors public.verify_certificate: anon can execute the resolver, base table has no anon grant.
